question:
In the following triads, each group of letters is related to the subsequent one following a certain logic. Select from the given options, the one that follows the same logic.

WORK-OWRK - KOWR

FERN - EFRN - NEFR
solution:
The pattern followed here is:

WORK-OWRK - KOWR

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cb5fed81b7d663f849be0e809c6f317e46a68a24a2c508aecb3b03eb974f1c8c.png] 

FERN - EFRN - NEFR

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1c183e750b68dca0f8fa62efd58a4d12e7af8cc1bf448ad9897daa6384310c9f.png] 

Similarly, 

**Option 3: WIND-IWND - DIWN**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/39eeca6b2c134be458bda04b8e69c19d88476cee381d9ce110cfa4f6d443e024.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3".**
